chief_complaint: Chronic disease management follow‑up focusing on hypertension, diabetes, and chronic kidney disease
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 58‑year‑old woman with long‑standing essential hypertension, insulin‑treated type 2 diabetes, and CKD stage 2 with micro‑albuminuria. Over the past few years she has had stable blood pressure (117/80 mmHg) and modest glycemic control (A1c 6.9%). CKD was first noted in 2015 (stage 1) and progressed to stage 2 in 2019. She reports ongoing stress but no acute complaints. Routine outpatient and wellness visits have been the primary source of care, with no emergency or inpatient encounters recorded up to the last visit in October 2021.
